title: Sr Service Support Coordinator
description:
Join a dynamic and customer-focused service organization where you will play a critical role in ensuring seamless coordination of field service activities and delivering an exceptional customer experience. As a Service Coordinator, you will work closely with customers, field engineers, and cross-functional teams to manage service operations, drive efficiency, and support the successful execution of service commitments. This is an exciting opportunity to be part of a collaborative, fast-paced environment where your organizational skills, problem-solving mindset, and ability to build strong relationships will directly contribute to customer success and operational excellence. Responsibilities Monitor service orders from initiation through completion, proactively identifying and resolving scheduling, logistics, or operational issues to minimize delays and improve service performance. Collaborate with field engineers, service managers, and cross-functional teams to ensure efficient execution of service commitments and adherence to operational processes. Maintain accurate service records, documentation, and system updates, ensuring data integrity and providing visibility into service performance. Track key service metrics and generate reports to support operational reviews, identify improvement opportunities, and drive continuous process optimization. Support business objectives by ensuring compliance with company policies, safety standards, and quality requirements while contributing to a culture of operational excellence and teamwork. Qualifications Bachelor s degree with 3-5+ years of experience in service coordination, field service operations, customer support, scheduling or a related operational role within a service-driven organization.
Strong organizational and planning skills, with the ability to manage multiple service requests, priorities, and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively interact with customers, field service engineers, and cross-functional stakeholders.
Proficiency in ERP, CRM, and service management systems (e.g., SAP, Salesforce, ServiceMax, or similar tools), along with strong Microsoft Office skills.
Demonstrated problem-solving and decision-making abilities, with a proactive approach to resolving scheduling, logistics, and customer service challenges.
Customer-focused mindset with strong attention to detail, data accuracy, teamwork, and a commitment to delivering high-quality service and operational excellence. Company Description Waters Corporation (NYSE:WAT) is a global leader in life sciences and diagnostics, dedicated to accelerating the benefits of pioneering science through analytical technologies, informatics, and service. With a focus on regulated, high-volume testing environments, our innovative portfolio harnesses deep scientific expertise across chemistry, physics, and biology. We collaborate with customers around the world to advance the release of effective, high-quality medicines, ensure the safety of food and water, and drive better patient outcomes by detecting diseases earlier, managing routine infections, and combating antibiotic resistance. Through a shared culture of relentless innovation, our passionate team of ~16,000 colleagues turn scientific challenges into breakthroughs that improve lives worldwide. Diversity and inclusion are fundamental to our core values at Waters Corporation. It benefits our employees, our products, our customers and our community. Waters complies with all applicable federal, state, and local laws. Qualified applicants are considered without regard to sex, race, color, ancestry, national origin, citizenship status, religion, age, marital status (including civil unions), military service, veteran status, pregnancy (including childbirth and related medical conditions), genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, legally recognized disability, domestic violence victim status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Waters is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. All hiring decisions are based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs at the time. 

This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.

title: AI Architect
description:
About this opportunity: Join Ericsson as a Senior Software Architect AI, owning end-to-end architecture for enterprise-scale GenAI and AI-powered solutions within our Self-Service Platform (SSP). You will design scalable, secure, production-grade AI platforms leveraging agentic frameworks, LLMs, and cloud-native services. You will establish reference architectures across RAG, memory, evaluation, and observability while guiding teams across the full model lifecycle at the intersection of AI innovation and Responsible AI governance. What you will do: Architect agentic AI applications using LangChain, LangGraph, and orchestration patterns; define prompt strategies, guardrails, and structured outputs aligned to product and risk requirements. Design and optimize RAG solutions (chunking, embeddings, retrieval, re-ranking) and own foundation model integrations (Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, on-prem LLMs) with routing, fallbacks, and cost/performance optimization. Define GenAI reference architectures; evaluate and select LLMs, embedding models, vector databases, and orchestration frameworks based on performance, compliance, and cost. Embed security, privacy, and Responsible AI governance from inception — covering PII handling, data access controls, and content guardrails. Build scalable backend APIs using Python (FastAPI, asyncio) with REST/JSON-RPC interfaces and resilience patterns (Redis, RabbitMQ); guide teams on MLOps/LLMOps standards including deployment, monitoring, retraining, and drift handling. Define LLM evaluation strategies, implement observability/tracing (Arize, LangSmith), and design memory strategies with retention and replay safety for long-running assistants. Containerize and deploy services via Docker and Kubernetes; govern CI/CD pipelines with automated testing, security scanning, and IaC (Terraform or equivalent). The skills you bring: BE/B.Tech/MCA in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent, with 15+ years in software architecture and relevant 3+ years  designing AI/ML or LLM-based systems in production. All academic credentials must be from recognized and accredited institutions and are further subject to verification.” Deep expertise in Python (FastAPI, asyncio) and ML/DL frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow); strong experience with distributed, cloud-native services. Hands-on with RAG pipelines, embeddings, and vector databases (Elastic, Pinecone, Milvus, Chroma) for enterprise knowledge grounding. Hands on Python experience mandatory Proven experience with agentic GenAI frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, AutoGen) and interoperability patterns such as Model Context Protocol (MCP). Strong knowledge of LLM architectures, fine-tuning techniques (LoRA, PEFT), and experience with Azure OpenAI and/or AWS Bedrock. Solid understanding of MLOps/LLMOps, Responsible AI principles, and embedding governance into GenAI design.
Proficiency with Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, and CI/CD for cloud-native AI deployments. Good to Have: LLM observability tools (Arize, LangSmith), Azure enterprise services (AKS, Key Vault), memory frameworks (MemGPT, LangMem), knowledge graph experience, and Telecom industry AI adoption background. Locations: Bangalore, Kolkata, Gurgaon, Noida, Chennai

Key Skills: Python,Architecture,Artificial Intelligence

 Company: Times Fibrefill Pvt. Ltd. Location: Maheshtala, South Kolkata, West Bengal Department: Stores & Inventory Employment Type: Full-Time Experience: Minimum 2 years of total work experience(preffered) 
 Job Summary : Times Fibrefill Pvt. Ltd. is looking for a responsible and organized Store Assistant to support daily store operations, inventory management, material handling, documentation, and coordination with production and other departments. The candidate will be responsible for maintaining accurate stock records, ensuring timely material issuance, and supporting the smooth movement of raw materials, work-in-progress (WIP), and finished goods. 
 Key Responsibilities : 1. Store & Inventory Management - Assist in receiving, storing, issuing, and dispatching materials. Maintain accurate stock records for raw materials, WIP, and finished goods. Monitor stock levels and inform the Store Supervisor about shortages or excess inventory. Conduct regular physical stock counts and assist in reconciling discrepancies. Ensure proper labeling, categorization, and storage of materials to prevent damage or loss. Issue fiber bales, WIP, and finished goods as per authorized requirements. 2. Material Handling & Documentation - Assist in preparing and maintaining material challans, stock registers, and other store-related documents. Verify incoming and outgoing materials against invoices, challans, and supporting documents. Support the preparation of Goods Receipt Notes (GRNs) for received materials. Maintain proper records of material receipts, issues, returns, and transfers. Ensure all documentation is updated and properly filed. 3. Production Coordination - Coordinate with the production team for timely issuance of raw materials and WIP. Support production planning by ensuring the availability of required materials. Follow up with the Store Supervisor regarding material shortages and urgent requirements. Assist in maintaining proper stock of production materials and finished goods. 4. Quality & Vendor Coordination - Assist in checking incoming materials for quantity, visible damage, and discrepancies. Report defective, damaged, or incorrect materials to the Store Supervisor immediately. Support the segregation and return of defective materials to suppliers as instructed. Coordinate with the relevant team for material replacement and corrective action. 5. Finished Goods & Dispatch Support - Assist in maintaining finished goods inventory and proper storage. Support packing, carton checking, and preparation of packing lists before dispatch. Verify material quantities against dispatch documents and challans. Coordinate with the dispatch and merchandising teams to ensure timely shipment preparation. Report any mismatch or discrepancy to the Store Supervisor before dispatch. 6. Store Organization & Safety - Maintain cleanliness, orderliness, and proper arrangement of the store. Follow company procedures for safe material handling and storage. Ensure materials are stored in designated locations and are easily traceable. Support periodic stock audits and other store-related activities assigned by management.

 Experience & Qualifications : Minimum 1-2 years of total work experience required. Previous experience in a Garments industry store, warehouse, manufacturing unit, or factory environment is preferred. Graduation/Diploma preferred. Experience in handling raw materials, WIP, and finished goods will be an advantage. Interested candidates with relevant store or warehouse experience are encouraged to apply. at - hr@timesfiberfill.com

Gather business requirements, analyze processes, and translate them into SAP MM functional solutions. Manage the Procure-to-Pay (P2P) cycle, including purchase requisitions, purchase orders, goods receipts, invoice verification, and vendor management. Troubleshoot and resolve SAP MM issues and provide functional support to business users. Work closely with SAP FI, SD, PP, and WM/EWM teams for cross-functional integration. Prepare functional specifications for reports, interfaces, enhancements, and forms. Conduct functional testing, integration testing, and user acceptance testing (UAT). Prepare functional documentation, user manuals, and training materials. Support data migration, master data validation, and process improvements. 
 Required Skills and Qualifications Minimum 6+ years of hands-on experience in SAP MM. Strong knowledge of SAP MM configuration and procurement processes. Experience in the complete Procure-to-Pay (P2P) lifecycle. Good understanding of inventory management, valuation, and account determination. Experience with SAP ECC and/or SAP S/4HANA. Knowledge of integration with SAP FI, SD, PP, and warehouse management modules. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills. Experience in client interaction, requirement gathering, and stakeholder management. Ability to work independently and collaborate with cross-functional teams. 
 Preferred Qualifications SAP MM certification is an added advantage. Experience in end-to-end SAP implementation, rollout, or support projects. Exposure to SAP S/4HANA procurement processes and Fiori applications is desirable.

 WHO WILL SUCCEED HERE

 • Are confident communicating with clients

 WORK STRUCTURE 5 Days Work From Office (Gurgaon)

 GROWTH PATH High performers can grow into: Project Lead – AI Operations

 Growth is performance-driven and ownership-based.

description:
Role Summary 
 The Graduate Engineer Trainee will support the Business Development & Sales team in identifying business opportunities, understanding customer power-generation requirements, preparing techno-commercial proposals, and coordinating the sales process for diesel generator sets and related solutions. 
 The position is intended for a recent engineering graduate seeking to build a career in technical sales. The trainee will receive practical exposure to diesel engines, alternators, control panels, acoustic enclosures, fuel systems, installation requirements, project coordination, customer relationship management, and commercial negotiations. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Business Development 
 Research potential customers, projects, consultants, contractors, dealers, and channel partners within assigned markets. Generate and qualify leads through customer visits, telephone calls, email campaigns, referrals, exhibitions, industry directories, and digital platforms. Identify opportunities in segments such as manufacturing, construction, infrastructure, commercial buildings, hospitals, hotels, data centres, telecom, utilities, and institutions. Assist in developing new markets, customer segments, dealer networks, and strategic accounts. Monitor market developments, upcoming projects, competitor activity, product positioning, and customer requirements.

Support post-delivery coordination, including installation, commissioning, warranty, and service handover.

description:
Job Description Zonal Service Manager Company: Oben Electric
 Department: After-Sales Service
 Location: Zonal / Field-Based
 Experience: 10+ Years
 Industry Preference: Electric Vehicles (EV), Automotive, Two-Wheeler, or Automobile Service Role Overview Oben Electric is looking for an experienced and result-oriented Zonal Service Manager to lead after-sales service operations across an assigned zone. The role will be responsible for managing service networks, driving customer satisfaction, ensuring service quality, improving dealer and service partner performance, and achieving key service operational targets. The ideal candidate should have strong technical knowledge of automotive service operations, excellent dealer management skills, and the ability to lead field service teams in a fast-paced EV environment. Key Responsibilities 1. Zonal Service Operations Manage and oversee after-sales service operations across the assigned zone, ensuring consistent service standards across dealerships and authorized service centres. Drive service performance, operational efficiency, and adherence to company service policies and processes. Monitor service centre productivity, turnaround time (TAT), repair quality, and customer complaint resolution. Conduct regular field visits to dealerships and service centres to assess operational performance and identify improvement areas. 2. Dealer & Service Network Management Support the development, onboarding, and operational readiness of authorized service centres and dealer service networks. Monitor dealer performance against service KPIs and implement corrective action plans where required. Ensure adequate availability of service tools, diagnostic equipment, spare parts, and trained technicians across the zone. Build strong relationships with dealers and service partners to improve service delivery and customer experience. 3. Customer Experience & Complaint Management Drive customer satisfaction through timely resolution of service complaints and escalations. Monitor customer feedback, service quality, repeat repairs, and customer satisfaction metrics. Coordinate with internal teams to resolve critical technical issues and recurring customer concerns. Implement initiatives to improve customer retention and overall after-sales experience. 4. Technical Support & Quality Improvement Coordinate with technical, product, engineering, and quality teams to resolve complex vehicle issues. Analyse recurring failures, warranty claims, and service trends to identify root causes and implement preventive measures. Ensure proper execution of service campaigns, product updates, recalls, and technical service bulletins, as applicable. Drive first-time-right repairs and minimize repeat complaints. 5. Spare Parts & Warranty Management Ensure timely availability and efficient distribution of spare parts across the service network. Monitor spare parts consumption, inventory levels, pending orders, and stock availability. Oversee warranty claim processing, validation, and timely closure in line with company policies. Work with supply chain and warehouse teams to address parts shortages and improve service readiness. 6. Team Management & Capability Development Lead, mentor, and develop zonal service teams, field service engineers, and service centre personnel. Identify training needs and ensure technicians and service advisors receive appropriate technical and process training. Conduct regular performance reviews and drive accountability against individual and team KPIs. Build a strong service culture focused on customer satisfaction, technical excellence, and operational discipline. 7. Performance Monitoring & Reporting Track and report key service metrics, including service turnaround time, customer satisfaction, warranty costs, repeat repairs, service revenue, and spare parts availability. Analyse zonal performance and prepare periodic reports for senior management. Develop action plans to improve service productivity, reduce operational costs, and enhance service network performance. Ensure compliance with company policies, applicable safety standards, and relevant service regulations. Required Qualifications & Experience Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Mechanical, Automobile, Electrical, or a related engineering discipline. 6–10 years of experience in after-sales service operations, preferably in the automotive or electric two-wheeler industry. Prior experience managing service operations across multiple locations or a geographical zone. Strong understanding of vehicle diagnostics, repair processes, warranty management, spare parts operations, and dealer service networks.

 We're looking for a consultant with experience in Manufacturing and Operational Excellence to join EY GDS-SCO. This is an exciting opportunity to work on manufacturing transformation and operational excellence engagements across industries and geographies. You will work closely with client teams and EY practitioners to support the assessment, design, and implementation of manufacturing transformation initiatives, helping clients improve productivity, reliability, quality, and operational performance. You will be responsible for executing tasks with increasing autonomy, applying sound judgment within defined parameters, and contributing to team outcomes. You are expected to demonstrate initiative, resolve routine issues independently, and support junior colleagues. You will anticipate and identify risks within engagements and share any issues with senior members of the team. In line with EY commitment to quality, youll confirm that work is of high quality and is reviewed by the next-level reviewer. 

 Your Key Responsibilities 
 Support analysis of as-is operating models for manufacturing clients and identify performance improvement opportunities Assist in developing future-state manufacturing operating models aligned with business objectives and performance targets Support the design and implementation of manufacturing transformation frameworks and performance management systems Support deployment of Manufacturing Excellence work processes across sites, ensuring adherence to standards, governance, and capability-building initiatives Participate in Operational Excellence programs focused on productivity, reliability, quality, and supply chain performance improvement Support change management initiatives, training programs, and capability-building activities at shopfloor and leadership levels Assist in implementing Smart Factory and Digital Manufacturing solutions Support the implementation of improvement initiatives such as OEE improvement, TPM, SMED, Predictive Maintenance, 5S, Continuous Improvement, and quality enhancement programs Engage with shop-floor teams to understand operational challenges, collect data, and support implementation of improvement initiatives Assist in digital transformation engagements involving Power BI, MES, Industrial IoT, Advanced Analytics, and Smart Factory technologies Support assessment and utilization of manufacturing systems including MES, ERP, QMS, CMMS/EAM, and manufacturing analytics platforms Perform data analysis on manufacturing and operational data and generate actionable insights for client stakeholders Support governance activities, KPI tracking, maturity assessments, and benefits realization efforts Prepare client presentations, workshop materials, analyses, and implementation documentation Contribute to development of EY manufacturing transformation methodologies, assets, and knowledge repositories Work collaboratively with cross-functional and global teams to deliver client engagements successfully

 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to structure data and derive meaningful insights Strong core consulting skills including research, logical structuring, storyboarding, and business presentation development Self-motivated and proactive team player with a continuous improvement mindset. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills Ability to work effectively in dynamic client environments and manage multiple priorities. Strong attention to detail and commitment to delivery excellence Willingness to learn and develop expertise in manufacturing transformation, operational excellence, and digital manufacturing Strong business acumen combined with a hands-on implementation orientation

title: Key Accounts Manager
description:
Job summary 
 The Key Account Manager owns Crescent's relationship with a portfolio of major OEM customers and channel partners. You will treat each account as a business: understand its financials, build and run a growth plan, and coordinate Crescent's plants, engineering, quality and logistics teams to deliver on it. 
 The role will initially focus on material handling, construction equipment and agricultural OEMs in Europe and Far East Asia. You will be expected to grow share of wallet with existing customers and win new part numbers and new programmes. 
 JOB RESPONSIBILITIES Account strategy and growth Build and execute an annual account plan for each assigned customer, covering volume (tonnes), revenue, margin and new-part targets. Map each customer's organisation (purchasing, engineering, quality, supply chain, plant management) and build relationships at every level, up to senior leadership. Track customer programmes, platform launches and sourcing cycles to spot opportunities early. Identify and pursue new business within existing accounts, including new part numbers, new plants and new regions. Monitor competitor activity and pricing in each account and recommend responses. 
 Commercial management Lead RFQ responses: gather drawings and requirements, coordinate costing with engineering and plants, and prepare and present quotations. Negotiate pricing, annual agreements, raw-material and freight indexation, payment terms and Incoterms. Own the account P&L: tonnage, revenue, contribution margin and receivables. Manage commercial routes to market where business flows through distributors, partners or trading companies, protecting Crescent's long-term position with the end customer. 
 New product development and launch Act as the customer's single point of contact through sample development, PPAP or first-article approval, and ramp-up to series production. Work with engineering and tooling teams on design-for-casting inputs, weight and tolerance changes, and machining and coating specifications. Keep sample and approval timelines on track and escalate risks early. 
 Customer service and operations Coordinate forecasts, schedules and call-offs with planning, plants and the overseas warehouses. Drive on-time delivery and resolve supply, quality and logistics issues quickly, including 8D and corrective-action follow-up with the quality team. Run regular business reviews with customers covering delivery, quality, cost and upcoming opportunities. 
 Reporting Maintain accurate account data, pipeline and forecasts in SAP and the CRM. Report monthly on target versus actual by customer and product unit, with clear explanations for gaps and recovery plans. For Senior KAM: manage and coach Account Executives and make sure their work aligns with Crescent's strategy and customer plans.

Key Skills: Account management,Marketing,Management,Key,Business development,Generation,Key accounts,Documentation

title: Data Integration Engineer (Senior Associate)
description:
Job Summary Grant Thornton GTech s Data Analytics function is dedicated to designing and delivering robust global data platforms that enable business solutions and high-quality analytics. The Analytics Engineer is responsible for building curated, analytics-ready datasets and semantic models that bridge data engineering and analytics, enabling trusted reporting and self-service consumption within the organization s Data Lakehouse. This hands-on role focuses on transformation development (dbt), dimensional modeling, semantic-layer and BI delivery (Power BI), and data quality. Working closely with Business teams, Data Architects, Data Engineers, and Analysts, the Analytics Engineer turns business requirements into well-structured, governed, and performant data products that serve as a trusted foundation for analytics, reporting, and AI. Responsibilities Design, build, and maintain curated, analytics-ready (gold-layer) datasets and semantic models that enable trusted reporting and self-service consumption. Develop and maintain modular, well-documented data transformations using dbt, following established engineering standards and reusable patterns. Build and optimize dimensional models (star/snowflake schemas, data marts) aligned with the Medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold layer separation). Develop semantic models, metric definitions, and certified datasets in Snowflake and Power BI to support consistent, governed analytics consumption. Translate business and reporting requirements into transformation logic and business rules in partnership with data analysts and stakeholders. Conduct data profiling, validation, and reconciliation using Snowflake SQL to ensure the accuracy, completeness, and integrity of analytics outputs. Perform data lineage and impact analysis across Snowflake, upstream sources, transformation layers, and reporting layers. Implement data quality checks, tests, and observability for analytics pipelines and datasets. Optimize Snowflake queries, models, and transformations for performance, reliability, and cost efficiency. Collaborate with data engineers, ETL/ELT developers, and QA, and support UAT to resolve data-related gaps through iterative testing and validation. Apply governance-by-design practices (access, classification/metadata, certified datasets), and mentor and guide more junior team members. Skills Proven experience with Machine Learning, predictive analytics, and natural language processing. Strong programming skills in SQL and Python for data validation, profiling, reconciliation, and analytics. Strong hands-on Snowflake experience is required, including, ability to construct optimize complex SQL queries, variant/JSON parsing, schema and stage understanding, performance analysis troubleshooting, dynamic tables/materialized views, dbt-on-Snowflake (Streams Tasks), and secure views/masking for certified datasets. Working experience in Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold data layers) including mapping data flows across layers. Strong hands-on experience with dbt for building and maintaining modular, tested data transformations (ELT/ETL development and maintenance). Hands-on experience building semantic models and reports in Power BI (metric definitions, certified datasets, and self-service enablement). Experience developing curated, analytics-ready (gold-layer) datasets and reusable transformation patterns.

title: Senior Engineer-Production and Testing
description:
Job Summary We are seeking an experienced Senior Engineer Production & Testing with 15+ years of hands-on experience in the manufacturing and testing of power and distribution transformers. The ideal candidate will own day-to-day shop-floor production and the transformer test bay, ensuring output meets production schedules, quality standards, and customer/third-party test requirements. The role demands strong practical command of the full manufacturing sequence and of routine, type, and special testing, along with close coordination with the design, quality, planning, and stores functions. 
 Key Responsibilities Production Plan, execute, and supervise daily shop-floor production across core cutting, coil winding, core-coil assembly, drying (vacuum/VPI), tanking, and final assembly, in line with the production schedule and released drawings. Interpret General Arrangement (GA), core, winding, and tank/fabrication drawings, GTPs, and process sheets released by the design office, and translate them into accurate shop-floor execution. Achieve daily and monthly production targets through effective manpower deployment, shift planning, and line balancing. Monitor in-process quality at each manufacturing stage and ensure adherence to work instructions, process parameters, and applicable IS/IEC standards. Coordinate with design, quality, production planning, stores, and procurement to ensure material availability, smooth WIP flow, and timely resolution of shop-floor bottlenecks. Drive productivity improvement, cycle-time reduction, and optimal utilisation of raw materials (CRGO, copper/aluminium conductors, insulation, oil), minimising scrap and rework. Implement and sustain 5S, Kaizen, housekeeping, and shop-floor safety practices. 
 Key Responsibilities Testing Plan and conduct routine, type, and special tests as per IS 2026 / IEC 60076 — including turns ratio, winding resistance, insulation resistance, no-load and load losses, impedance, temperature rise, applied/induced overvoltage, and impulse tests, as applicable to the plant range. Conduct routine and acceptance tests in the presence of third-party inspection agencies and customer witnesses (CPRI / third-party) — a priority requirement of this role. Operate and supervise the test bay, ensuring correct test setups, instrument readiness, and full compliance with test-safety protocols. Maintain calibration status, test records, and traceability for all measuring and test instruments. Prepare, review, and finalise test reports, ensuring conformity with GTP and customer specifications before dispatch clearance. Diagnose test failures, drive root-cause analysis with production and design, implement corrective/preventive action, and re-test. 
 Required Skills & Expertise Strong hands-on experience across the complete transformer manufacturing process — core cutting, coil winding, core-coil assembly, drying/VPI, tanking, and final assembly. In-depth practical knowledge of transformer testing — routine, type, and special tests, test-bay operation, and test instrumentation. Ability to read and interpret GA, core, winding, and tank/fabrication drawings, GTPs, and customer technical specifications. Sound working knowledge of relevant standards: IS 2026, IEC 60076, IS 1180, CBIP guidelines, and ANSI, as applicable. Good understanding of raw materials — CRGO steel, copper/aluminium conductors, insulation materials, and transformer oil. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and root-cause-analysis skills for production and test-floor issues. Manpower management, shift planning, and production-planning capability. Familiarity with quality management systems (ISO) and shop-floor improvement tools (5S, Kaizen). Strong communication and cross-functional coordination skills (production, quality, testing, design, procurement). Leadership ability to guide shop-floor teams, technicians, and junior engineers. 
 Qualifications B.E. / B.Tech in Electrical Engineering (Mandatory); M.E./M.Tech or Diploma with extensive relevant experience considered. 15+ years of relevant experience in power/distribution transformer production and testing , with a significant portion in a factory/test-bay environment. Prior hands-on experience in a transformer manufacturing plant is strongly preferred. 
 Key Attributes Detail-oriented with strong ownership of production targets and test integrity. Comfortable working on the shop floor and in the test bay. Proactive, hands-on problem solver who performs under production timelines. Strong team player with the ability to lead technicians and mentor junior engineers.

title: Sr. Manager Supply Chain Performance
description:
Job Summary Sr Manager- Supply Chain Performance Position Summary The Senior Engineer I - Supply Chain Performance is responsible for driving end-to-end supply chain excellence through performance management, planning optimization, inventory control, operational analytics, continuous improvement, and cross-functional coordination. The role ensures alignment between customer demand, production capabilities, material availability, and business objectives while leading initiatives that improve service, cost, inventory, and productivity performance. This position serves as a key catalyst for operational excellence by deploying digital tools, performance governance, and continuous improvement methodologies across the plant and supply chain network. Responsibilities Supply Chain Performance Management Establish and monitor supply chain KPIs including OTD, OTDC, Service Level, Inventory Turns, DOH, Forecast Accuracy, Backlog, and Lead Time. Conduct regular performance reviews and identify improvement opportunities. Develop dashboards and digital reporting systems to support data-driven decision making. Drive visibility of risks, bottlenecks, and recovery plans across the supply chain. Planning & Execution Excellence Support SIOP/SPIOP processes to ensure alignment between demand and supply. Analyze demand trends, capacity constraints, and inventory implications. Coordinate closely with Planning, Manufacturing, Procurement, Logistics, and Customer Care teams. Ensure execution of production and material plans to meet customer commitments. Inventory & Working Capital Optimization Drive inventory reduction initiatives while protecting customer service levels. Monitor slow-moving, excess, obsolete, and non-moving inventory. Improve inventory accuracy and warehouse performance. Support working capital improvement objectives. Continuous Improvement & Digitalization Lead Lean Supply Chain and Continuous Improvement projects. Apply problem-solving methodologies such as Kaizen, DMAIC, PDCA, and Root Cause Analysis. Deploy digital tools, automation, Power BI dashboards, and analytics solutions. Standardize reporting and governance processes across functions. Cross-Functional Leadership Facilitate collaboration among Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Procurement, Quality, Finance, and Engineering teams. Lead performance review meetings and action-tracking mechanisms. Support strategic projects including localization, capacity expansion, business continuity, and network optimization. Customer Service & Operational Excellence Improve customer service performance through proactive risk management. Ensure timely escalation and resolution of supply chain issues. Drive actions to improve responsiveness, flexibility, and operational reliability. Support customer satisfaction and business growth objectives. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) On-Time Delivery (OTD) On-Time Delivery to Customer (OTDC) Service Level Inventory Turns Days of Inventory (DOI) Forecast Accuracy Backlog Reduction Material Availability Working Capital Productivity Savings Supply Chain Cost Continuous Improvement Savings Qualifications Education Bachelors Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Operations Management, or related discipline. MBA / APICS / Lean Six Sigma certification preferred. Experience 8-12 years of experience in Supply Chain, Manufacturing Operations, Planning, Industrial Engineering, or Continuous Improvement. Experience in manufacturing environments such as Electrical Distribution, Switchgear, Industrial Automation, or related industries preferred. Technical Competencies Supply Chain Planning SIOP / Integrated Business Planning Inventory Management Demand & Capacity Planning Performance Analytics Power BI / Tableau SAP / ERP Systems Lean Manufacturing Project Management Leadership Competencies Influencing without Authority Stakeholder Management Strategic Thinking Problem Solving Change Management Results Orientation Cross-Functional Collaboration Communication & Presentation Skills

Job Description: The Release Manager is responsible for planning, scheduling, coordinating, and managing software releases across the enterprise for multiple applications and teams. They work closely with development, QA, operations, and project teams to ensure successful deployments and minimal risk to production environments. 
 Key Responsibilities: Plan and manage the release calendar across multiple products and platforms. Coordinate release content and effort based on the service request backlog, pending service requests, third-party applications, or operating system updates. Conduct Release Readiness reviews and Milestone Reviews. Manage risks and resolve issues that affect release scope, schedule, and quality . Communicate all key project plans, commitments, and changes including requirements, QA plans, schedule, and scope changes. Maintain a release repository and manage key information such as build and release procedures, dependencies, and notification lists . Work with DevOps and infrastructure teams to improve deployment processes and automation. Ensure compliance with change management policies and audit r equirements. Participate in CAB (Change Advisory Board) meetings and provide release-related inputs.

title: Support Engineer -Payments
description:

The support engineer will: Independently prioritize and manage incoming work and support requests. Analyze issues to identify root causes and track progress in the ticketing system. Keep stakeholders informed and maintain awareness of ongoing issues. They communicate directly with stakeholders, often operational specialists in the Finance department, Software developers and Product managers. They have excellent analytical skills and enjoy the challenge of getting to the root of inconsistencies in financial information that require investigation into multiple systems, databases, and log files. The support engineer provides a first line of support and can triage issues reported by different stakeholders. description:
Job Summary 
 We are seeking a Senior Quality Consultant with strong experience in Quality Assurance and regulatory compliance for SAP S/4HANA implementations within regulated environments. The role focuses on ensuring quality, validation, and compliance across SAP S/4HANA programs by embedding robust quality governance, supporting audit readiness, and enabling compliant digital transformation initiatives. The consultant will work closely with business, IT, validation, and quality stakeholders to support SAP S/4HANA implementations aligned with GxP regulations, data integrity principles, and global regulatory expectations.  Qualifications 
 Bachelors or Masters degree in Biotechnology, Engineering, or related field. 5+ years of experience in Quality Assurance, Validation, Regulated Compliance or GxP environments within pharmaceutical, life sciences or consulting organizations Handson experience supporting SAP implementations, preferably SAP S/4HANA, in regulated environments Strong understanding of Quality Management Systems (QMS) and core quality processes (Deviation, CAPA, Change Control, Document Management, Training) Strong understanding of global regulatory requirements including, ICH and ISO Guidelines, 21 CFR Part 11, Annex 11, EU GMP Consulting or clientfacing experience preferred. Excellent communication, documentation, and stakeholder management skills. 

 Must-have Skills & Attributes 
 Quality Assurance and compliance experience for SAP S/4HANA or SAP ECC implementations. Strong understanding of CSV / CSA principles and riskbased validation approaches. Experience supporting validation lifecycle activities (impact assessment, risk assessment, testing, traceability, reporting) Strong understanding of Quality Management Systems (QMS), including Deviation, CAPA, Change Control, Document Management, and Training processes. Experience supporting audits, inspections, and compliance assessments, including CAPA tracking and remediation. Hands-on experience with quality and enterprise systems such as Trackwise, Veeva Vault, SAP, LIMS, or similar platforms. Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams (Business, IT, Operations, Manufacturing, Labs). Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. Effective stakeholder management and client-facing skills in a consulting environment. 

 Good-to-Have Skills & Attributes 
 Exposure to digital quality transformation initiatives, including implementation or enhancement of QMS platforms. Familiarity with Agile delivery models and working in cross-functional project environments. Awareness of AI/ML use in regulated environments and associated quality/governance considerations. Exposure to process optimization and operational excellence initiatives. Experience contributing to business development activities (proposals, presentations, client interactions). Ability to contribute to standardization, innovation, and practice development initiatives. 

 What we look for

Main Responsibility Main job responsibilities of blood centre technologists are as follows (but not limited to): Perform Blood Centre operations as per SOPs, quality and regulatory requirements. Conduct donor screening, phlebotomy and VBD camps. Perform ABO/Rh grouping, immunohaematology, cross-matching and compatibility testing. Conduct TTI screening and blood component separation/processing. Ensure proper identification, labelling, traceability, storage and inventory of blood/components. Maintain records, documentation and accurate Blood Centre software/LIS entries. Follow biosafety, infection-control and occupational-safety practices. Properly handle samples, reagents, equipment and consumables and report discrepancies/adverse events. Assist in quality control, calibration, maintenance and related documentation. Maintain technical-area housekeeping and cleanliness. Coordinate with MOIC/MO, nursing, front office and operations teams. Maintain donor and patient confidentiality. Perform other duties assigned by MOIC/MO/Head Operations. Competencies Knowledge of Blood Centre/Blood Bank procedures, SOPs and regulatory requirements. Hands-on skills in blood collection, phlebotomy, VBD camps, grouping, cross-matching, immunohaematology, TTI testing and component separation. Understanding of storage, handling and inventory management. Knowledge of quality management, biosafety and infection control. Accuracy in documentation, software/LIS entry, identification, labelling and traceability. Good communication, teamwork and interpersonal skills. Ability to work effectively during camps and busy operations. Responsible, disciplined and detail-oriented, with ability to identify/report errors and technical issues. Commitment to donor/patient safety, quality and regulatory compliance.

title: Associate Territory Manager (ERO)
description:
Job Summary Job Title: Associate Territory Manager. Function: Commercial. Reports to: Area Manager. Location: Kolkata. Travel Required: 25% - 75%. Position Overview. The Senior Business Development Executive/Associate Territory Manager is responsible for driving revenue growth within the assigned Area by effectively managing the sales process for all products, including Domestic Priority (DP), International, Retail, Cargo, and E-Retail. The role will also focus on revenue enhancement through channel partners such as Regional Service Providers (RSPs), Consolidators, Franchise Collection Centres (FCCs), and One-Stop Centres (OSCs). The incumbent will play a crucial role in customer acquisition, relationship management, and adherence to company sales policies. Job Purpose. This role will focus on managing the end-to-end sales cycle, ensuring customer satisfaction, and driving sustained business development. It requires a highly motivated and target-driven individual with a strong understanding of the logistics and courier industry. Key Roles & Responsibilities Monitor and drive Area revenue performance to achieve targeted sales growth and profitability. Evaluate the profitability of key accounts and take corrective measures to achieve profit targets. Track product-wise yields regularly and develop action plans to meet set targets. Manage the end-to-end sales process for the Area, ensuring revenue growth for all products. Develop and maintain strong relationships with existing customers, ensuring revenue retention. Identify and drive new business opportunities through channel partners. Monitor and enhance channel partner performance in terms of revenue, sales, and profitability. Support sales capability-building initiatives for sales teams and channel partners. Ensure adherence to Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) among sales teams and channel partners. Implement sales and marketing strategies to enhance market share and profitability. Follow up and ensure closure of product-specific sales leads received from telemarketing or other departments. Negotiate rates and service offerings with customers within set approval limits. Maintain and update prospect details in the Saffire system on a daily basis. Address and resolve customer service issues in coordination with internal and external stakeholders. Provide insights to the Branch Sales Head regarding modifications to existing product offerings to enhance revenue and profitability. Ensure achievement of collection targets within the set remittance cycle and Days Sales Outstanding benchmarks. Guide and support the sales team to ensure high performance and goal alignment. Ensure optimal staffing levels within the Area sales team. Qualifications & Experience Education Essential: Graduate degree in Business Administration, Sales, Marketing, or a related field. Preferred: An MBA or Postgraduate degree in Sales & Marketing. Experience 1-3 years of experience in sales, business development, or key account management in the logistics, courier, supply chain, or e-commerce industry. Experience in B2B sales, managing channel partners, and driving revenue growth is an added advantage. Skills & Capabilities Technical Skills Strong understanding of sales processes, revenue management, and market expansion strategies. Experience in logistics, courier services, or supply chain management. Proficiency in using sales tracking tools like Saffire and Avature. Knowledge of data analytics and business intelligence tools for tracking sales trends and performance. Key Competencies Result-oriented: Strong drive to achieve sales targets and revenue growth. Customer-Centric: Ability to develop and maintain strong customer relationships. Analytical Thinking: Proactive approach to market analysis and business development. Negotiation & Influence: Strong persuasion skills to drive sales and revenue enhancement. Key Performance Indicators Growth in Area Revenues. % achievement of product-wise and channel-wise revenue targets. Achievement of yield targets (Yield per piece) for all products. Drive Market Growth. % increase in revenues from key industry segments and key accounts. Enhance Revenues via Channel Partners. Revenue targets achieved through RSPs and other channel partners. Ensure Timely Collections. Achievement of remittance targets. Reduction in outstanding receivables (e.g., 60-day, 90-day, 150-day buckets). Drive Sales Capability, Productivity, and Process Adherence. Achievement of Sales KPIs and compliance with SOPs. New Product Development. Successful implementation of new products in the Area. Foster a Performance-Driven Culture. Timely adherence to Performance Management System guidelines. Drive Employee Morale and Engagement. Employee retention and engagement metrics.

title: Senior Manager - Administration (East Region)
description:
Job Title: Senior Manager - Administration (East Region) Location: Kolkata 
 Job Purpose Responsible for leading Administration operations across the East Region, ensuring safe, compliant, efficient, and business-ready workplaces that support IndiGo's operational and growth objectives. The role is accountable for administration governance, facilities management, infrastructure readiness, stakeholder management, vendor performance, statutory and regulatory compliance, crisis response, and operational continuity across airport and non-airport locations. The incumbent will work closely with regional business leaders, airport operators, regulatory authorities, government agencies, and service partners to ensure seamless operational support, high service standards, business continuity, and a positive workplace experience across the region. 
 Key Responsibilities Regional Administration Leadership Lead end-to-end administration operations across the East Region covering offices, airport facilities, operational bases, ticketing offices, cargo facilities, and other business support locations. Ensure all locations remain safe, compliant, operationally ready, and aligned with business requirements. Drive service excellence, governance, operational discipline, and standardization across the regional portfolio. Monitor regional priorities, operational risks, service issues, and infrastructure requirements, ensuring timely resolution and escalation. Support business growth through administration readiness for new locations, workplace changes, infrastructure enhancements, and expansion initiatives. Facilities & Infrastructure Management Oversee maintenance, housekeeping, workplace services, utilities, employee amenities, and infrastructure support across all locations. Manage facilities operating within critical, high-security, and operationally sensitive environments, ensuring adherence to airport, aviation, safety, and security requirements. Drive approved refurbishment, expansion, and workplace improvement initiatives. Oversee space utilization, workplace planning, and administration asset lifecycle management. Drive initiatives to enhance workplace experience, employee wellbeing, and service delivery standards. Ensure facilities consistently support business continuity, operational requirements, and employee productivity. Stakeholder Management & Business Partnering Act as the primary Administration interface for regional leadership teams, airport stakeholders, station teams, and corporate functions. Build and maintain effective relationships with airport operators, regulatory bodies, government agencies, local authorities, service providers, and key external stakeholders. Partner with HR, Finance, Procurement, Security, Operations, Engineering, Cargo, and other functions to support business objectives. Represent the Administration function in operational reviews, governance forums, and stakeholder discussions. Drive timely resolution of stakeholder concerns and facilitate alignment across internal and external stakeholders. Vendor Governance & Commercial Management Lead sourcing, onboarding, governance, and performance management of administration and facilities service providers. Negotiate and manage contracts and service agreements to ensure service excellence, compliance, and commercial value. Monitor vendor performance through SLAs, scorecards, periodic reviews, and corrective action plans. Drive cost optimization and budget discipline while maintaining required service standards. Support budgeting, expenditure monitoring, and cost visibility across the regional administration portfolio. Compliance, Risk & Governance Ensure compliance with all applicable statutory, regulatory, airport, safety, security, environmental, and company requirements. Maintain readiness for audits, inspections, certifications, and compliance reviews, ensuring timely closure of observations. Coordinate with internal teams, airport authorities, and regulatory agencies on compliance-related matters. Identify and mitigate operational, compliance, and infrastructure risks to safeguard employee safety and business continuity. Promote adherence to established SOPs, governance standards, and internal controls across the region. Crisis Management & Business Continuity Lead administration response during emergencies, infrastructure failures, operational disruptions, and crisis situations. Coordinate with airport authorities, emergency services, local agencies, service providers, and internal stakeholders to minimize operational impact. Drive contingency planning, escalation management, and business continuity preparedness across the regional portfolio. Implement corrective and preventive actions arising from incidents and operational disruptions. Reporting & Continuous Improvement Maintain accurate operational reporting, dashboards, records, and management reviews. Monitor service delivery, vendor performance, compliance status, and key operational metrics. Identify improvement opportunities and drive process simplification, standardization, and service enhancement initiatives. Team Leadership Lead, coach, and develop regional administration teams through effective performance management, capability building, and succession planning. Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, service excellence, and continuous improvement. Conduct structured reviews of priorities and team deliverables to ensure alignment with business objectives. Qualifications Essential Bachelor's Degree in any discipline. Preferred MBA / PGDM. Certification in Facilities Management, Workplace Management, Infrastructure Management, Project Management, Business Continuity Management, or related disciplines. 
 Desired Experience 12+ years of relevant experience in Administration, Facilities Management, Workplace Services, Corporate Infrastructure, Real Estate Operations, or Business Support functions within a large multi-location organization. Demonstrated experience managing geographically dispersed administration and facilities portfolios across multiple locations. Experience in aviation, airports, hospitality, logistics, infrastructure, manufacturing, retail, or other operationally intensive environments will be preferred. Experience in airport administration, aviation operations, or management of facilities within operationally critical and high-security environments will be preferred. Strong understanding of facility operations, compliance requirements, and business continuity practices. Proven experience managing relationships with airport operators, regulatory authorities, government agencies, service providers, and key business stakeholders. Strong commercial acumen with experience in vendor management, contract administration, budgeting, and cost optimization. Demonstrated experience in crisis management, incident response, and business continuity support. Strong knowledge of the regional operating environment, stakeholder ecosystem, and local business landscape. Preference will be given to candidates with experience operating in the East Region. Knowledge of Bengali and/or other regional languages will be an advantage. Critical Competencies Functional Competencies Administration & Facilities Management Workplace Services Management Stakeholder Management Vendor & Contract Management Compliance & Governance Crisis Management & Business Continuity Budget & Cost Management Infrastructure Planning & Readiness Service Delivery Excellence Risk Management Leadership Competencies Strategic Thinking Stakeholder Influence Collaboration & Relationship Management Decision Making Problem Solving Team Leadership Change Management Execution Excellence Customer & Service Orientation

Role: NPD (New Product Development) -Procurement 
Department: NPD 
Experience: Fresher (0-1 year) 
Location: Kolkata (Work from Office) 
Employment Type: Full-time

Note: - Fresher or 1+ year experience candidates with a Bachelors degree in B.Com are applicable. 

About the Role:
We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented NPD to join our team. The role will involve supporting the development and procurement of packaging materials, coordinating with vendors, and ensuring the right balance between cost, quality, timelines, and product requirements.
The ideal candidate should have a strong interest in procurement, packaging, vendor management, and cost optimization, along with good communication and negotiation skills.

Key Responsibilities:
1 . Packaging Procurement 
- Coordinate the procurement of packaging materials such as bottles, tubes, cartons, labels, pouches, jars, caps, pumps, and other components.
- Source and evaluate new vendors based on price, quality, MOQ, capacity, and lead time.
- Collect and compare quotations from multiple suppliers.
- Track purchase orders, production status, dispatches, and deliveries.
- Ensure materials are procured as per approved specifications and timelines.
2. Vendor Management 
- Develop and maintain strong relationships with existing and new vendors.
- Coordinate with vendors for quotations, samples, production updates, quality issues, and deliveries.
- Follow up regularly to ensure timely execution of orders.
- Identify alternate vendors to improve competitiveness and reduce dependency.
- Maintain an updated vendor database with pricing, MOQ, lead time, and other commercial details.
3. Cost Optimization 
- Identify opportunities for cost reduction across packaging components.
- Benchmark vendor prices and negotiate for better commercial terms.
- Compare material specifications and alternate solutions to achieve cost efficiencies without compromising quality.
- Support the team in achieving procurement cost-saving targets.
- Track changes in packaging costs and maintain updated rate comparisons.
4. NPD / Packaging Development 
- Coordinate with internal teams for new packaging requirements.
- Communicate packaging specifications and requirements to vendors.
- Coordinate sampling, modifications, approvals, and finalization of packaging components.
- Follow up on tooling, moulds, samples, trials, and commercial production wherever applicable.
- Ensure packaging development timelines are aligned with product launch requirements.
5. Coordination Documentation 
- Coordinate with Design, RD, Quality, Operations, Finance, and other internal teams.
- Maintain proper records of quotations, samples, specifications, purchase orders, and vendor communications.
- Prepare cost comparison sheets and procurement reports.
- Track pending actions and ensure timely closure.

 What We Are Looking For 
 - Fresher with a Bachelors degree in B.Com 
- Strong interest in procurement, sourcing, packaging, and vendor management.
- Good communication and negotiation skills.
- Good command of MS Excel / Google Sheets. 
- Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
- Ability to manage multiple vendors and follow up on several activities simultaneously.
- Detail-oriented with a strong sense of ownership.
- Willingness to learn about packaging materials, manufacturing processes, and commercial negotiations.

 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs): 
The candidate will be evaluated on:
- Vendor response and negotiation effectiveness
- Timely procurement and delivery
- New vendor development
- Reduction in procurement lead times
- Accuracy of cost comparisons and documentation
- Successful execution of new packaging development
- Vendor performance and issue resolution

Why Join Us
This role provides an opportunity to gain hands-on exposure to packaging procurement, vendor negotiations, cost optimization, and new product development in a fast-paced D2C environment. 
The candidate will work closely with multiple teams and vendors and will get end-to-end exposure to the packaging procurement and NPD process.

title: Senior Manager - Administration (East Region)
description:
Job Title: Senior Manager - Administration (East Region) Location: Kolkata 
 Job Purpose Responsible for leading Administration operations across the East Region, ensuring safe, compliant, efficient, and business-ready workplaces that support IndiGo's operational and growth objectives. The role is accountable for administration governance, facilities management, infrastructure readiness, stakeholder management, vendor performance, statutory and regulatory compliance, crisis response, and operational continuity across airport and non-airport locations. The incumbent will work closely with regional business leaders, airport operators, regulatory authorities, government agencies, and service partners to ensure seamless operational support, high service standards, business continuity, and a positive workplace experience across the region. 
 Key Responsibilities Regional Administration Leadership Lead end-to-end administration operations across the East Region covering offices, airport facilities, operational bases, ticketing offices, cargo facilities, and other business support locations. Ensure all locations remain safe, compliant, operationally ready, and aligned with business requirements. Drive service excellence, governance, operational discipline, and standardization across the regional portfolio. Monitor regional priorities, operational risks, service issues, and infrastructure requirements, ensuring timely resolution and escalation. Support business growth through administration readiness for new locations, workplace changes, infrastructure enhancements, and expansion initiatives. Facilities & Infrastructure Management Oversee maintenance, housekeeping, workplace services, utilities, employee amenities, and infrastructure support across all locations. Manage facilities operating within critical, high-security, and operationally sensitive environments, ensuring adherence to airport, aviation, safety, and security requirements. Drive approved refurbishment, expansion, and workplace improvement initiatives. Oversee space utilization, workplace planning, and administration asset lifecycle management. Drive initiatives to enhance workplace experience, employee wellbeing, and service delivery standards. Ensure facilities consistently support business continuity, operational requirements, and employee productivity. Stakeholder Management & Business Partnering Act as the primary Administration interface for regional leadership teams, airport stakeholders, station teams, and corporate functions. Build and maintain effective relationships with airport operators, regulatory bodies, government agencies, local authorities, service providers, and key external stakeholders. Partner with HR, Finance, Procurement, Security, Operations, Engineering, Cargo, and other functions to support business objectives. Represent the Administration function in operational reviews, governance forums, and stakeholder discussions. Drive timely resolution of stakeholder concerns and facilitate alignment across internal and external stakeholders. Vendor Governance & Commercial Management Lead sourcing, onboarding, governance, and performance management of administration and facilities service providers. Negotiate and manage contracts and service agreements to ensure service excellence, compliance, and commercial value. Monitor vendor performance through SLAs, scorecards, periodic reviews, and corrective action plans. Drive cost optimization and budget discipline while maintaining required service standards. Support budgeting, expenditure monitoring, and cost visibility across the regional administration portfolio. Compliance, Risk & Governance Ensure compliance with all applicable statutory, regulatory, airport, safety, security, environmental, and company requirements. Maintain readiness for audits, inspections, certifications, and compliance reviews, ensuring timely closure of observations. Coordinate with internal teams, airport authorities, and regulatory agencies on compliance-related matters. Identify and mitigate operational, compliance, and infrastructure risks to safeguard employee safety and business continuity. Promote adherence to established SOPs, governance standards, and internal controls across the region. Crisis Management & Business Continuity Lead administration response during emergencies, infrastructure failures, operational disruptions, and crisis situations. Coordinate with airport authorities, emergency services, local agencies, service providers, and internal stakeholders to minimize operational impact. Drive contingency planning, escalation management, and business continuity preparedness across the regional portfolio. Implement corrective and preventive actions arising from incidents and operational disruptions. Reporting & Continuous Improvement Maintain accurate operational reporting, dashboards, records, and management reviews. Monitor service delivery, vendor performance, compliance status, and key operational metrics. Identify improvement opportunities and drive process simplification, standardization, and service enhancement initiatives. Team Leadership Lead, coach, and develop regional administration teams through effective performance management, capability building, and succession planning. Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, service excellence, and continuous improvement. Conduct structured reviews of priorities and team deliverables to ensure alignment with business objectives. Qualifications Essential Bachelor's Degree in any discipline. Preferred MBA / PGDM. Certification in Facilities Management, Workplace Management, Infrastructure Management, Project Management, Business Continuity Management, or related disciplines. 
 Desired Experience 12+ years of relevant experience in Administration, Facilities Management, Workplace Services, Corporate Infrastructure, Real Estate Operations, or Business Support functions within a large multi-location organization. Demonstrated experience managing geographically dispersed administration and facilities portfolios across multiple locations. Experience in aviation, airports, hospitality, logistics, infrastructure, manufacturing, retail, or other operationally intensive environments will be preferred. Experience in airport administration, aviation operations, or management of facilities within operationally critical and high-security environments will be preferred. Strong understanding of facility operations, compliance requirements, and business continuity practices. Proven experience managing relationships with airport operators, regulatory authorities, government agencies, service providers, and key business stakeholders. Strong commercial acumen with experience in vendor management, contract administration, budgeting, and cost optimization. Demonstrated experience in crisis management, incident response, and business continuity support. Strong knowledge of the regional operating environment, stakeholder ecosystem, and local business landscape. Preference will be given to candidates with experience operating in the East Region. Knowledge of Bengali and/or other regional languages will be an advantage. Critical Competencies Functional Competencies Administration & Facilities Management Workplace Services Management Stakeholder Management Vendor & Contract Management Compliance & Governance Crisis Management & Business Continuity Budget & Cost Management Infrastructure Planning & Readiness Service Delivery Excellence Risk Management Leadership Competencies Strategic Thinking Stakeholder Influence Collaboration & Relationship Management Decision Making Problem Solving Team Leadership Change Management Execution Excellence Customer & Service Orientation

title: Export Manager
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION 
 Export Logistics Manager/Senior Executive 
Operations & Documentation | Freight & Customs | Sea Shipments
 
 
 
 About the Role 
We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive Export Logistics Executive to join our international trade team. The incumbent will be responsible for end-to-end management of sea export shipments from pre-shipment documentation and customs clearance through to post-shipment banking formalities. The ideal candidate brings hands-on experience with export documentation, a solid understanding of Letter of Credit (LC) transactions, and the ability to coordinate seamlessly across shipping lines, freight forwarders, CHA agents, and bank teams.
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Shipment Planning & Coordination 
 Plan and execute FCL / LCL sea export shipments across designated trade lanes.
 Coordinate with freight forwarders, shipping lines, and CHA agents for bookings, container allocation, and vessel scheduling.
¢ Monitor container movement from stuffing to vessel departure and provide timely updates to stakeholders.
¢ Handle 50+ TEU / month (volume as applicable to role level).
 
 Export Documentation 
¢ Prepare and verify all pre-shipment documents: Commercial Invoice, Packing List, Shipping Bill, ARE-1 / ARE-3, SDF / GR forms.
¢ Coordinate with CHA for Shipping Bill filing on ICEGATE; resolve customs queries and amendments.
¢ Issue and manage Bills of Lading (B/L) Original, Surrender, Switch, and Telex Release.
¢ Prepare Bank Covering Letters and submit complete post-shipment document sets to the bank within stipulated timelines.
¢ Maintain document registers and ensure 100% compliance with DGFT / RBI export regulations.
 
 Letter of Credit (LC) Management 
¢ Scrutinise LC terms upon receipt; flag discrepancies and liaise with the buyer / issuing bank for amendments.
¢ Prepare LC-compliant document sets (Sight / Usance / Standby) adhering to UCPDC 600 guidelines.
¢ Coordinate with the negotiating bank for LC negotiation, bill discounting, and realisation of export proceeds.
¢ Maintain LC-wise tracking and ensure zero discrepancies in submissions.
 
 Compliance & Reporting 
¢ Ensure timely BRC (Bank Realisation Certificate) closure and EDPMS (Export Data Processing & Monitoring System) compliance.
¢ Liaise with auditors / DGFT for export obligations, advance licence, and EPCG licence matters.
¢ Prepare weekly / monthly MIS reports on shipment status, freight costs, and document TAT.
¢ Stay updated on changes in customs tariff, EXIM policy, and RBI circulars.
 
 Required Qualifications & Experience 
¢ Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Business Administration, Logistics, or a related field.
¢ 2 6 years of direct experience in export logistics / freight forwarding / international trade documentation.
¢ Proven hands-on experience with sea freight exports (FCL / LCL).
¢ Strong knowledge of export documentation: Shipping Bill, B/L, Commercial Invoice, Packing List, COO, Phytosanitary Certificate (as applicable).
¢ Working knowledge of Letter of Credit (LC) scrutiny, compliance, and negotiation.
¢ Familiarity with ICEGATE, EDPMS, and RBI / DGFT regulations.
¢ Good understanding of INCOTERMS 2020 (EXW, FOB, CFR, CIF, DDP).
¢ Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word); experience with ERP / trade management software is a plus.
 
 Preferred Qualifications 
¢ Experience with AEO (Authorised Economic Operator) status procedures.
¢ Prior exposure to SEZ / bonded warehouse / deemed exports.
¢ Exposure to import-side documentation (Bill of Entry) for holistic supply-chain visibility.
¢ Working knowledge of EXIM trade finance instruments (Bank Guarantee, Standby LC, Buyers Credit).
¢ Certification in Export-Import Management (IIFT / FIEO / equivalent) is advantageous.
 
 Competency Framework 
 
 Competency AreaKey Indicators to EvaluateDocumentation Accuracy ¢ Ability to prepare error-free pre & post shipment documents
¢ Zero-discrepancy LC document sets
¢ Compliance with UCPDC 600 & RBI norms Logistics Execution ¢ Sea freight booking & container management
¢ Coordination with shipping lines, CHA, freight forwarders
¢ Container tracking & exception handling LC & Banking Knowledge ¢ LC scrutiny and discrepancy identification
¢ Bank submission within stipulated TAT
¢ EDPMS & BRC closure discipline Communication ¢ Clear verbal and written communication with banks, buyers, and customs
¢ Ability to negotiate freight rates
¢ Stakeholder reporting and MIS preparation Process & Compliance ¢ EXIM policy awareness & DGFT compliance
¢ ICEGATE filing proficiency
¢ Audit readiness and record management 
 What We Offer 
¢ Competitive CTC with performance-linked incentives.
¢ Opportunity to work across diverse trade lanes and commodity types.
¢ Structured learning path with exposure to import documentation and trade finance.
¢ Collaborative work culture with cross-functional exposure (Sales, Finance, Supply Chain).
¢ Company-sponsored training in EXIM regulations and LC management.
 
 How to Apply

 hr.spyarns@gmail.com | 9147700901 
 This document is confidential and intended solely for recruitment purposes. | S.P Yarns Confidential
